description: Call ChargePoint's commercial accounts line directly — not through Kevin's bank framing — and get first-hand confirmation of their revenue-share terms for a two-station Level 2 installation at an independent fuel retail site. I want their actual per-kWh revenue split, whether they cover hardware under a host agreement, and the realistic monthly revenue range for a moderate-traffic site. I am not selling to them; I am vetting them the same way they would vet me. Simultaneously, call Priya Sharma today and ask her to quote a business owner's policy (BOP) that covers property, liability, and business interruption for a fuel-and-EV-charging retail site. I have 4 dependents and no coverage. That is not a footnote — it is a structural failure I have been deferring. I am not deferring it past this tick.

targets.purpose: First-hand revenue-share confirmation before signing loan paperwork
targets.expected_outcome: Verified per-kWh split, hardware cost structure, realistic monthly revenue range for a site like mine

targets.purpose: Business Owner Policy quote covering property, liability, and business interruption
targets.expected_outcome: A real monthly premium number so I can fold insurance cost into my EV charger decision framework

rationale: The term sheet is in my hands. The one missing piece is first-hand ChargePoint numbers rather than the bank's framing of them. Once I have that, I have everything I need to make the loan decision next tick. Insurance is not optional anymore — it was optional when savings were growing. Savings dropped $1,839 on a routine tick. The margin for unmitigated risk is gone.
emotional_state: Controlled urgency. The grief stage is still depression but the agency is real. I am not waiting for better conditions. I am building a decision that can survive the conditions that are actually here.
decision_pending: EV charger loan commitment — targeting tick 8 once ChargePoint terms confirmed
